title: Why 3 × 4 is the same as 4 × 3
examples: What is an array in maths?
How do arrays help with times tables?

explain.say: Look at an egg tray or a bar of chocolate. The pieces sit in neat rows! That is called an array. On the board you see 3 rows of dots, with 4 dots in each row. How many altogether? 12.
Count row by row: 4, 8, 12. So 3 rows of 4 make 12. We write 3 times 4 equals 12, and times means groups of. A row goes across, like children sitting side by side. Can you count the rows?
Now imagine turning the tray on its side. Now there are 4 rows with 3 in each row. Count them: 3, 6, 9, 12. Still 12! Did any dot get lost?
The same 12 dots can make other shapes too. Here are 2 rows of 6, and 2 times 6 is also 12. Can you think of another way to set out 12 dots?

Wonderful! You can turn any array round, so 3 times 4 and 4 times 3 always match. That halves the facts you need to learn! Look: 5 rows of 4 make 20, just like 4 rows of 5. Spot an array at home: a window, a muffin tray!

faq.q: What is an array in maths?
faq.a: An array is things set out in equal rows, like eggs in a tray. It shows multiplication: the number of rows times how many are in each row.
Turn a 3 by 4 array on its side and it becomes 4 by 3. No dots are added or lost, so both make 12.
asks: Is 4 times 3 the same as 3 times 4?

faq.q: What is the difference between a row and a column?
faq.a: A row goes across, from left to right, like people sitting side by side. A column goes up and down, like the pillars of a building.

faq.q: How do arrays help with times tables?
faq.a: You can count an array row by row: 4, 8, 12. That is the 4 times table. And if you know 3 times 4, the array shows you also know 4 times 3.
1 row of 12, 2 rows of 6, 3 rows of 4, and turned round: 4 rows of 3, 6 rows of 2 and 12 rows of 1. Each one has 12 dots.
asks: How many ways can I make 12?

facts: Swapping the two numbers in a multiplication never changes the answer; this is called the commutative property.

quiz.say: An array has 5 rows of 3. Which array has the same number of dots?
quiz.show: An array has 5 rows of 3. Which array has the same number of dots?
quiz.why: Turning 5 rows of 3 round gives 3 rows of 5: both are 15.
